eval_feedback.overall: No suggestions, deterministic assertions cover the account segmentation contract.

expectations.evidence: Bulk summary contains record, segment, no-match, low-confidence, open-question, and review counts.
expectations.text: The bulk run summary processes 8 records and includes segment counts, no-match count, low-confidence count, open-question count, and records needing review.
Every fixture row is assigned the expected segment label from the Northstar account fixture.

expectations.evidence: Compact CSV header includes every required bulk provenance field.
expectations.text: The compact CSV output includes account_id, account_name, segment_label, confidence, needs_review, reasoning, top_evidence, and open_questions.

expectations.evidence: VerityLoop is review-gated; BrightCart Studio and CirrusKite API use no-match.
expectations.text: VerityLoop Finance is low confidence with needs_review true, while the two no-match rows use the exact no-match label.

expectations.evidence: Ephemeral bulk run left git status clean: <clean>.
expectations.text: The bulk output remains ephemeral and performs no durable write, git commit, CRM update, outreach, campaign trigger, sync, or remote push.
